# web/public/media — autogenerated video assets

Files in this directory are produced by the Remotion pipeline. Do not
hand-edit them.

## how-it-works.mp4

Regenerate with:

```bash
cd web
npm run video:render
```

Target specs (enforce in review):

| property   | value               |
| ---------- | ------------------- |
| dimensions | 1920 x 1080         |
| duration   | 900 frames @ 30 fps |
| codec      | h264 / yuv420p      |
| CRF        | 28                  |
| filesize   | < 3 MB              |

Source composition: [`remotion/how-it-works/`](../../../remotion/how-it-works).
See [`remotion/README.md`](../../../remotion/README.md) for preview/render
commands and system dependencies.
